decision.headline: Conditional support for one separately frozen Earth/G/awake spatial-calibration experiment if strict nested base probabilities can be reused at low cost; no direct correction from these diagnostic OOF arrays. The sleeping third-bin pattern does not justify another spatial model.
decision.sleeping_third_bin: Observed rate125/126=.9921; raw Mitra mean probability .9641/.9711/.9683, versus v44 .8712/.8736/.8753. Mitra third-minus-other-bin unexplained differences .0431/.0337/.0387 have all three descriptive group-cluster95 intervals crossing zero. Do not motivate another model by the raw .992 rate alone.
decision.awake_pattern: Observed third-bin83/112=.7411 vs Mitra .6708/.6742/.6736; the preceding bin is observed .2835 vs Mitra .3704/.3722/.3773. Third-minus-other-bin residual contrast stays about+.10 in all three partitions; this is more specific evidence of residual spatial compression than the sleeping high-rate region.
decision.classification_counterevidence: Both models already predict all126 sleeping third-bin rows positive at0.5 in all three splits and each makes one error. Raising their probabilities cannot fix that error. In the awake third bin, Mitra predicts82/84/83 positives vs83 actual positives, with21/19/18 errors: average probability underestimation alone does not identify which individuals should flip.
decision.caution: The bins/focal region arose from exploratory reused labels; repeated partitions share all targets, model-training dependence is omitted by the simple group SE, and many cells were viewed. These intervals are not independent confirmation or a multiple-testing-corrected significance claim.
decision.if_root_pursues: Freeze eligibility Earth & DeckG & observed CryoSleep=False, both Sides and all four existing rank bins before any candidate score, with no third-bin-only override or cutpoint search. Train the calibration from strictly nested outertrain-only base OOF probabilities; compare with a matched self-only calibration control. Specify shrinkage/objective once, not against these residuals. Existing sleeping-only spatial expert is not an equivalent awake test.
decision.nested_cache_reuse_boundary: Root reports a separately planned raw-Mitra/Kumo nested gate may supply raw-Mitra innerOOF without additional GPU. Reuse only if outertrain/query IDs, fold construction, base recipe/preprocessing and fit seeds match the spatial experiment exactly and artifact/source hashes verify. Random-outer gate innerOOF is not reusable as group-outer meta training merely because both contain the same6954development rows. Cache availability is not asserted here.
decision.accuracy_limit: Calibration residual alone need not change0.5 decisions; the reported focal classification counts expose this distinction. No claim of attainable extra correct predictions, superiority to v81/v93, or irreducible accuracy ceiling.
decision.authorization: This report does not authorize fitting, scoring a correction, or uploading.
